SELECT DISTINCT r.id AS role_id, r.role_code, dp.scope_type, dp.include_children, dp.operation_mode FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.id JOIN sys_permission permission ON permission.id = rp.permission_id JOIN sys_role_data_policy dp ON dp.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' AND permission.enabled = TRUE AND permission.permission_code = #{permissionCode} AND dp.status = 'ACTIVE' AND dp.domain_code = #{domainCode} AND dp.dimension_code = #{dimensionCode}
AND dp.operation_mode = 'READ_WRITE'
